_comment: Copy to ~/.pi/vision.config.json (all projects) or .pi/vision.config.json (one repo). When the session model is text-only, screenshots go to relayModel and the session gets a description. Empty relayModel = first vision-capable model with auth. /vision model <provider/id> persists relayModel.
_maxImageBytesPerRequest: Images sent with one request (base64 bytes). Older screenshots past it are left out of what is sent; the session keeps them. 33554432 = 32 MiB, 0 = no limit.
